description.en: Proterosuchus fergusi inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m art asset, not a biological measurement. Source SAM-PK-11208 Fig3a skull plus published composite full skeleton Fig3h (Parrish1986, Gregory Paul) in Ezcurra Butler Gower2013 author public figure. Composite not one articulated specimen. Soft tissue, color, pose and exact dimensions artistic. No osteoderms, no texture or mesh copied.

scientific_scope.intentional_overlap: Closed body and underside overlap internally; neck, four sprawling limb roots, joint segments and tail root overlap deliberately at anatomical joints. Closed components not watertight union. Four limbs only.
